what_this_is: Every known route from each registered curve's discrete logarithm into a Jacobian, priced by one frozen formula-level cost model against Pollard rho on the same subgroup; see docs/curves/JACOBIAN_TRANSFERS.md. Rows are formulas and leads, never measurements or security claims.

formula_advantage: descent to a genus-5 cover C/GF(p) of E/GF(p^5)
